title: Raw Salmon Tobiko Gunkan
description: Nori boats filled with diced raw salmon, Japanese mayonnaise, scallions and tobiko.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

ingredients.name: Salmon intended for raw consumption, unless cooked

steps: Dice chilled raw-consumption salmon into small cubes, approximately 5 mm.
Gently fold salmon with Kewpie and finely sliced scallions; keep chilled.
Form six rice ovals of about 25 g each and wrap with nori strips rising above the top.
Fill with salmon mixture and top each with about 2 g tobiko. Serve immediately.
notes: Prepare and handle the raw topping under refrigeration.
Baseline makes approximately six light servings. Ingredient quantities can be scaled independently.
Prepare and season sushi rice using its separate recipe.
For uncooked salmon, use a reputable raw-consumption supplier, keep chilled and assemble promptly.
